states.dynamic: Known source/schema callable returning Any must not gain guessed member facts downstream.

states.dependency_change: Change a defining module, then query its unopened/dirty importer and compare current facts with a fresh workspace.

states.stale_version: Deliver an old document version or generation and verify it cannot replace current facts.
